note: Fulton County campground on Metropolitan Water Reclamation District land near Canton, among IDNR-stocked strip-mine lakes; mostly seasonal campers (private docks by lot number), with electric and non-electric overnight sites. The shower house, water pump and dump run May through October. No rate is posted (the county's price page is empty); an earlier $30 a night for electric is unconfirmed. --Claude
